title: Matzo, Broad Bean and Leek Pie
subtitle: a layered potato and matzo bake
description: Layers of matzo and a mashed potato, leek and broad bean filling, baked until golden. It can be made a day ahead and reheated.

steps.text: Boil the peeled and halved potatoes in plenty of boiling water until soft. Reserve 1 cup of the cooking water, drain the potatoes and transfer to a wide bowl.

Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced leeks and a little salt, stir for about 1 minute, then add the broad beans. Keep frying for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the leeks and beans are soft.

Remove from the heat and add the leeks and beans to the potato bowl. Mash to a loose puree with the texture of thick tahini, adding a little of the cooking water only as needed. Season with nutmeg, pepper and salt, and adjust. Once the puree has cooled, add the eggs and mix well.

Soak the matzo between damp towels for about half an hour beforehand. Preheat the oven to 170°C. Line a 20 x 15 cm tin with baking paper and grease lightly. Place one matzo in the tin, top with about a fifth of the puree, and cover with another matzo. Repeat with the remaining matzo and puree, finishing with a layer of puree. Run a fork over the top to make fine grooves and bake for 30 minutes until browned.
